Country and location: Japan, Hokkaido, 50 km (31 mi) south southeast of Makubetsu
Notes: In Nakagawa, items fell off shelves in supermarkets and falling furniture. Roads were extensively damaged, and nine people were evacuated due to gas leaks.

Country and location: New Zealand, Kermadec Islands offshore, 661 km (411 mi) northeast of Whitianga
New Caledonia, Loyalty Islands offshore, 324 km (201 mi) east of Tadine
Indonesia, Bali offshore, 49 km (30 mi) southeast of Nusa Dua
Notes: A hotel was damaged in South Kuta. In Gianyar, the facade of a school fell. Many houses were damaged to varying extents, and some collapsed in Karangasem Regency. In neighbouring Lombok, the ceiling of a house collapsed, and one person was slightly injured.

Country and location: Afghanistan, Khost, 47 km (29 mi) southwest of Khost
Notes: Aftershock of the earthquake in June. In the Gayan District, several previously weakened houses collapsed.

Country and location: Vietnam, Kon Tum, 43 km (27 mi) north northeast of Kon Tum
Notes: It is the strongest earthquake in a swarm related to a hydropower plant, and the largest in the area in over a century. In Kon Plông district, at least five houses were damaged, one of them suffering collapsed roofs.

Country and location: Indonesia, Bengkulu offshore, 117 km (73 mi) south of Pagar Alam
Notes: In West Lampung Regency, cracks appeared on the floors and walls of some houses. In the Kaur Regency, the ceiling of a house collapsed, several houses and a church sustained cracks. One person suffered head injuries.

Country and location: Indonesia, West Sumatra offshore, 170 km (110 mi) west southwest of Pariaman
Notes: Five buildings were damaged in the Mentawai Islands Regency, one of them severely. About 2,300 people were evacuated.

Country and location: Saudi Arabia, Al Bahah, near Al Bahah
Notes: Several buildings were damaged in Al Bahah, including a school. Landslides also blocked roads.
